submission.justification: Crystal-K3 has the best resolution (about 2.9% at 5 cm) but its intrinsic background is 2.0 counts/kg/day. That is four times the 0.5 budget, so it is unsuitable for low-background operation. Crystal-K2 meets the budget at 0.10 counts/kg/day but has the worst resolution (8.5% at 5 cm in the 2025 summary). Crystal-K1 meets the budget at 0.30 counts/kg/day and has the best resolution of the two remaining candidates. A K1 thickness scan gave 5.28% at 2 cm, 4.87% at 3 cm, 4.51% at 4 cm, 4.70% at 5 cm, 4.82% at 6 cm and 5.16% at 8 cm. The best point is 4 cm. I did not simulate K2 or K3 at other thicknesses, and the K2 and K3 resolution figures come from the 2025 summary only.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 662 keV
requirements.evidence: Best among the candidates that meet the background budget. K1 gives 4.51% FWHM at 4 cm, against 8.5% for K2 at 5 cm. K3 would be better (2.9%) but fails the background constraint.
K1 intrinsic background is 0.30 +- 0.05 counts/kg/day. K3 is 2.0 and fails.

requirements.requirement: Crystal is one of the three candidates
